title: Compose the Plant State trust-record list

gates.name: plant_state_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/plant-state.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser verification covers only the trust-record list, exact public fields, stable continuation, active/retained access, safe denial, and provider/internal-field absence.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-023 RED: no browser trust-record list consumer exists; GREEN: exact active and retained-authorized pages render the public projection with complete continuation while wrong-Plant cursor, denied scope, and internal/provider fields fail safely; decisive comparison: protected responses versus DOM and request transcript; artifact: Plant State list evidence under .tasks/TASK-087-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Expose the Plant State trust-record projection without allowing the PWA to assign trust, evidence, agent identity, attribution, or Safety meaning.
success_outcome: Authorized users can traverse the exact active or retained-history Plant State list while internal/provider fields and denied scope remain absent and the backend stays the sole trust authority.
anti_goals: Do not add human review mutations, accept client trust/evidence fields, or expose confirmation actor/provider/internal classification data.
Do not add batch review, conflict auto-resolution, Task creation, or physical-action approval.

stop_conditions: The PWA needs a trust mutation outside the exact Plant State review contract.
A conflict or archived path cannot fail without optimistic/client-owned trust state.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Plant State owns records, conflicts, versions, evidence, and review transitions.
The read consumer copies only the exact public list fields and canonical cursor.
invariants: Plant state is never confirmed by model or UI presentation alone.
Active, retained, and denied reads never mutate trust records.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-023: exact list fields, stable pagination, active/retained authority, wrong-Plant cursor rejection, and internal/provider-field exclusion.
T3 harm proof uses isolated records and verifies denied/malformed reads leave authoritative state unchanged.
